verdict.rationale: Navan's MCP docs say it can break down costs by department, vendor, or category, with examples grouped by department. Its Ava blog says it 'slices and dices real-time spend data', and the API exposes Navan card transactions, so spend visibility is tied to card activity rather than statements. missing for 10: explicit documentation of same-day transaction posting latency, a documented native real-time dashboard (the evidence centers on AI/MCP querying), and independent or hands-on corroboration of the real-time claim.
